rules: IF error_rate > 0.35 AND hint_frequency > 0.30 THEN Difficulty = EASY
IF error_rate > 0.35 AND hint_frequency <= 0.30 THEN Difficulty = NORMAL
IF error_rate <= 0.35 AND autonomy <= 0.75 THEN Difficulty = HARD
IF error_rate <= 0.35 AND autonomy > 0.75 AND speed <= 0.60 THEN Difficulty = HARD
IF error_rate <= 0.35 AND autonomy > 0.75 AND speed > 0.60 THEN Difficulty = EXPERT
